summary_1line: Yayati, fallen from heaven due to pride, is restored by the merits and devotion of his daughter’s sons and ascends again to the celestial realm.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yayati rises upward toward heaven without touching the earth as his daughter’s sons stand below offering the merit of their sacrifices.
Four royal grandsons stand around the fallen king, each proclaiming the merit of his virtues and sacrifices to lift their grandfather back to heaven.
In heaven, Yayati is welcomed again amid showers of fragrant flowers, celestial music, and Gandharvas singing as he regains his radiant form.
